name: Chokotto☆Vampire!
original_name: ちょこっと☆ばんぱいあ！
source:
Youichi is an ordinary uni student, and he wants to live an ordinary life. On the other hand, Youichi's father is a mayor, and he secretly runs away after a series of scandals. Youichi is at a loss what to do... and he receives a package. There is a huge coffin inside.... He opens it and finds a girl sleeping. She wakes up and says, "I am a descendant of a vampire family." A city office worker comes to his place and tells him that his father is a descendant of a traditional devil family, and he is decided to take over the devil after his father. At first, he refuses it and is given a couple of months to think it over. He finally accepts the offer to be the devil....

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
阳一是一名普通大学生，只想过平凡的生活。另一方面，身为市长的父亲却在一连串丑闻后暗中逃走。阳一不知所措……此时，他收到一个包裹，里面竟装着一具巨大的棺材……他打开棺材，发现其中沉睡着一名少女。少女醒来后说：‘我是吸血鬼家族的后裔。’一名市政府职员来到阳一家，告诉他，他的父亲是传统恶魔家族的后裔，而阳一已被选定继承父亲的恶魔之位。起初阳一拒绝了，并得到几个月的考虑时间。最终，他还是接受了成为恶魔的提议……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
